name: B10-0436/2026 – After § 3 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the pilot project on European Schools Alliances
part_text: 3a. Urges the Commission to ensure that the European Schools Alliances fully respect parents’ rights to determine the religious, moral and pedagogical upbringings of their children, and that EU-funded educational initiatives, in particular regarding sexuality education, do not impose ideological or political approaches, including gender-related concepts, that disregard parental convictions;
